plain: Whether power, including the power to oversee an AI, is gained and used fairly, stays answerable to real checks, and is exercised in the open.
eli5: Whether the people in charge got there fairly and can still be stopped if they do wrong.
technical: In Claude's constitution, a judgment about process (fair methods versus fraud or coercion), accountability (subject to elections, courts, press and oversight) and transparency, weighed with scale, reversibility and broad benefit; oversight from stolen weights or from bypassing Anthropic's official processes is not legitimate.
